statement.text: Dickson's conjecture : for a finite set of linear forms $a_{1}+b_{1}n,\ldots ,a_{k}+b_{k}n$ with each $b_{i}\geq 1$ , there are infinitely many $n$ for which all forms are prime , unless there is some congruence condition preventing it.

title: Dickson's conjecture
